title: Transactional Data: Official Government Mobile Applications
description: List of official government mobile applications registered with GAMMA, including their names, platforms, date of publication and purpose.

fields.name: app_id
fields.title: Application ID
fields.description: [Integer] Unique identifier for each government mobile application; this is intended as a lookup reference only, and has no external meaning.

fields.name: app_name
fields.title: Application Name
fields.description: [String] The official name of the government mobile application.

fields.name: app_os_platform
fields.title: Operating System Platform
fields.description: [Categorical] The operating system platform for the application: Android, iOS, or Huawei.

fields.name: released
fields.title: Released Date
fields.description: [Date] The date when the application was first published to the app store for that OS, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

fields.name: last_updated
fields.title: Last Updated Date
fields.description: [Date] The date when the application was last updated on the app store for that OS, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

fields.name: shutdown
fields.title: Shutdown
fields.description: [Date] The date when the application was shutdown or removed from the app store, in YYYY-MM-DD format. Null if still active.

fields.name: purpose
fields.title: Purpose
fields.description: [String] Description of the application's purpose and functionality.

methodology: Under the standards specified by the National Digital Department (JDN), all government mobile applications must be registered with the Malaysia Government Mobile Applications Gallery (GAMMA). This dataset represents an exact copy of the transactional data stored in the GAMMA database.
caveat: The data represents applications tracked via the Malaysia Government Mobile Applications Gallery (GAMMA) only. As such, official applications not yet registered in GAMMA may be absent from this dataset.
